new_finding_handed_off.title: C17's prose corpus sweeps 1,156 gitignored agent-system markdown files, so its headline is not reproducible across deploys
new_finding_handed_off.evidence: scripts/check-module-invariants.sh's prose_files() walks '.' for every *.md, excluding only .git, .lake, specs, Boneyard, build and __pycache__. Of the 1,322 prose files that reaches, 417 are under .claude/, 370 under .opencode/, 357 under .opencode_OLD/ and 12 under .memory/ -- agent-system deploy trees that are gitignored, regenerated on every extension reload, and about mathematics unrelated to this Lean library. Only about 166 are project documentation (docs/ 79, FormalSystem/**/README.md 60, Tests/ 10, data/ 5, root).
new_finding_handed_off.measured_impact: Exactly one declaration is masked today: `def isOpen` at FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/Closure.lean:134, whose only non-declaring occurrences are lines in .claude/context/project/math/topology/topological-spaces.md, .claude/context/project/math/topology/scott-topology.md and .claude/context/project/logic/domain/topological-foundations-domain.md, plus the identical .opencode/ and .opencode_OLD/ copies -- a coincidence of naming with point-set topology, not a reference. Excluding the four trees takes the flagged set 947 -> 948 and the headline 698 -> 699, removing nothing (the change is monotone, as narrowing an occurrence corpus must be).
new_finding_handed_off.proposed_action: A small task against scripts/check-module-invariants.sh: exclude .claude/, .opencode/, .opencode_OLD/ and .memory/ from the prose corpus that C17, C19 and C23 share, re-baseline C17's headline to 699, and record the rule in the script header and docs/development/MODULE_INVARIANTS.md. Same class of change as the six filters this task landed, and it does not gate C17. NOT created here -- task creation is the orchestrator's.
new_finding_handed_off.why_not_fixed_here: The task is closed and committed with its plan marked [COMPLETED] and its follow-up set (F1-F8) written. Reopening a closed task's artifacts to fold in a finding discovered after closure is worse than handing the finding to the orchestrator.
